title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
abstract: arXiv:2610.27583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark setting

translated_title: TeCoP：通过暂定上下文流水线加速扩散大语言模型解码
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型每次前向传播可预测多个词元位置，然而分块解码器将生成过程串行化，并反复重新计算已经稳定的预测。我们将这种低效归因于将预测的“不可逆提交就绪度”与“其作为上下文的效用”这两个角色耦合在了一起。我们提出了暂定上下文流水线，这是一种无需训练的解码器，通过错峰分块并行流水线和草稿-验证机制将这两种角色解耦。TeCoP将稳定但尚未提交的预测作为临时的跨块上下文复用，预测的提交与否由置信度和稳定性检查决定。在四个LLaDA和Dream扩散大语言模型上，针对GSM8K、Minerva MATH和MBPP基准测试，TeCoP将前向评估次数最多减少87%，在无KV缓存情况下相比未缓存的原始解码器实现最高7.50倍的吞吐量提升，在有缓存情况下达到11.77倍。在全部12个模型-基准组合设置中，其吞吐量均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB。
tldr: TeCoP是一种无需训练的扩散大语言模型解码方法，通过将稳定但未提交的预测作为暂定上下文进行跨块流水线复用，将前向评估次数最多减少87%，吞吐量最高提升11.77倍。
en_tdlr: TeCoP is a training-free decoder for diffusion LLMs that reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as tentative cross-block context through pipelining, reducing forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieving up to 11.77-fold throughput improvement.
